notes.title: YC126.11.28 GROUNDBREAK NOW OPEN TO ALL UNTIL 12 DECEMBER
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066515/8c601670ed8761f7478b3a969d1171017a1a2555.png[/img]
[b]Denizens of New Eden, [/b]

The Guristas insurgency is not over yet, so Vanguard forces are being kept on the ground for longer, and reinforcements are being rallied together. To that end, YC126.11.28 Groundbreak is being opened up to free access and extended until 12:00 UTC on 12 December. This means all access barriers are being removed, allowing all warclones to join, no codes or subscriptions required. In addition, Vanguard contribution to corruption or suppression in the cluster will be increased over the weekend, so make sure to take advantage of this boost while it lasts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066515/01ba56e42d13ec16577cde22007e581c4f8f80e4.png[/img]
[i]The Guristas Pirate Forward Operating Base in high orbit around planet III in Raihbaka, in the region of Black Rise.[/i]

If you have been waiting for a chance to introduce your friends to EVE Vanguard, they can now join you planetside for free. Gather your friends, jump into 9v9 skirmishes, and get ready to topple empires. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066515/84cc27bb09c576cb66ff91239faa2f19652eeff2.jpg[/img]

[h2]GLORY AND REWARDS[/h2]
Besides the glory associated with valor on the battlefield, participating in the current operation comes with additional rewards as warclones who spend more than one hour on the ground during the event will receive a stunning new gun skin, Seykal Fury, at a later date.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066515/a6907b3a5b52ec4ffcafcd084d992156b540cfc9.jpg[/img]

In addition, Omega clones who spend more than 10 minutes on the battlefield will receive a ship SKIN in EVE Online.  *To be eligible, you need to deploy in EVE Vanguard for more than 10 minutes. The reward crate will be claimable in the New Eden Store from 23:59 UTC on 13 December. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066515/f847649d8f7e059bd8b63ea2f2987f10e7414e7c.jpg[/img]

[i]* Alpha players who earned their reward before 12:00 UTC on 5 December will also receive their crate at 23:59 UTC on 13 December. [/i]

[h2]GET THE LATEST FRONTLINE REPORTS[/h2]
Make sure you stay up to date with the latest developments in YC126.11.28 Groundbreak by following the EVE Vanguard social channels: 

[list]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlayEVEVanguard/]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://x.com/PlayEVEVanguard]X[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/evevanguard]Discord[/url]
[/list]
Enter the [url=https://evevanguard.com/community]Community Hub[/url] to complete missions and earn unique Discord roles plus other future rewards. While there, you can also check out the latest live streams to see how other warclones are getting on when you need a break from the field of battle. 

Your footsteps on the ground will reverberate across the stars. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066515/e42aad84fe15c5d8d842993fd10addc1fcd25b4a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Themes of Vanguard: Mining
notes.content:
[h3]Between now and November, we will be sharing content in the form of [b]Themes[/b]. These Themes will cover multiple topics from art, lore, weapons and more to provide you insight into our development journey. Lets look at our sixth theme, MINING. [/h3]

[b]Goodbye banana, hello Cutting Tool![/b]
A versatile, equippable tool designed to interact with specific targets in the game world. Though it functions similarly to a weapon, the cutting tool is built to handle precision tasks, like cutting open mineral deposits, wreckage panels, or other materials that block access to valuable resources. It’s designed specifically for mining and exploration purposes, allowing you to retrieve resources or unlock containers and doors.

[b]How the Cutting Tool works:[/b]
[list]
[*] Emits a beam that damages mining targets, allowing you to extract resources or access hidden areas.
[*] Used to mine mineral deposits, cut open wreckage for salvage, and unlock containers or covered switches.
[*] Designed to damage targets that respond to frequencies generated by the cutting tool laser, such as ore-rich deposits or latches on wreckage.
[/list]
[b]Cutting Tool Design:[/b]
The cutting tool itself is a tough, rugged piece of kit designed to survive the harshest conditions. Its construction allows it to withstand extended use in unforgiving environments. Additionally, it’s designed to be easily disassembled, ensuring that players can maintain and repair it with minimal effort when needed, making it a reliable companion in exploration and mining operations.

The cutting tool is essential for players exploring hostile environments where quick access to resources or locked areas can mean the difference between success and failure. It’s not just a weapon or a tool, but a key piece of gear for exploration, salvage, and even survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066515/cf9db2108d2ea4e3c6c2acd1fb83cb73aaa4fe0b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066515/8e5d59002727bc6171d4d7a64bd3abc1e555f9c2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066515/0675c008f3aa92d3469c206e7255326f4b764a85.png[/img]

[b]Customizing your Cutting Tool[/b]
The cutting tool uses mining crystals, each tuned to specific frequencies that are most effective for cutting certain materials. Players need to experiment with these crystals through trial and error to find the right one for the job.

[b]Switching Crystals:[/b]
[list]
[*] Switching between crystal types is like swapping ammunition in a weapon. You can cycle through them to see which crystal works best for a particular material.
[*] Using the wrong crystal slows the process but the correct crystal will allow for faster, more efficient cutting.
[*] Crystals have limited durability, and once depleted, they must be replaced. Crystals cannot be repaired.
[/list]
[b]Mining Minigame:[/b]
The cutting tool introduces a simple, strategic element to mining: crafting the correct crystal to use for each material. Using the right crystal rewards players with faster cutting, while using the wrong one results in slower progress and may incur potential penalties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066515/bfd56b891e65811670e2238e0d990d10ae5e1479.gif[/img]

[b]Node Layers and Visual Feedback:[/b]
When mining resource nodes, players must cut through layers of material using the correct crystal type to speed up the process. Visual feedback, such as cracks or heat effects, will show how well the crystal is working. However, the process is more about experimenting with different crystals. If the wrong crystal is used, the cutting will take longer, encouraging players to switch crystals until they find the right one.

[b]Chipsets and Customization (concept):[/b]
Chipsets can be added to the cutting tool to improve its efficiency, regardless of which crystal is being used. These chipsets provide benefits such as:
[list]
[*]  [b]Durability:[/b] Each crystal has a limited lifespan, but using the wrong one simply slows progress rather than depleting it faster. Crystals must be replaced when depleted.
[*] [b]Yield:[/b] Enhances the amount of resources collected from nodes.
[*] [b]Speed:[/b] Shortens the cutting time, helping players mine resources faster.
[/list]
The idea is that these customizations offer the player flexibility depending on their playstyle—whether they prefer efficient resource gathering, faster gameplay, or a balance of both.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066515/253fd12e14be75e59364c5599367c9330bf53afd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066515/d184e82514b7dc972cdbb2774ede676c576f89b6.png[/img]

[b]Combat Feedback:[/b]
Although the cutting tool is not designed for combat, it can deal minor damage to characters. However, for the upcoming release, the feedback for damaging characters might be rudimentary. Expect a more developed combat feedback system in future updates.

Until next time,
o7

notes.title: Themes of Vanguard: Manufacturing
notes.content:
[h3]Between now and November, we will be sharing content in the form of [b]Themes[/b]. These Themes will cover multiple topics from art, lore, weapons and more to provide you insight into our development journey. Lets look at our fourth theme, MANUFACTURING. [/h3]

[i][b]Before we dive into our next theme, we want to express that this is a mock-up and you should take it with a heavy hand of salt. We do, however, want to show you a sneak peek at a possible new feature that is all about manufacturing and blueprints.[/b][/i]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1248017227865788436/1278709458847137812/gif_1.gif?ex=66fca33c&is=66fb51bc&hm=3816316072940c06ae8977379a435d6475ee59c66b986660434b7509e5ad510c&=&width=868&height=488[/img]

The idea is to change how we collect and use items in the game. Instead of just picking up full items, you'll gather 'fragments', little pieces of a recipe that you could put together to create blueprints. These blueprints could let you craft items multiple times, which means you can hold onto your favourite gear a bit longer and not worry so much about losing it right away. 

What's cool about this? 

[olist]
[b][*] Blueprints & Fragments:[/b] Think of fragments as puzzle pieces. You collect them during your deployment, and once you have enough, you can trade them in to make blueprints. These blueprints are like your personal recipe cards, letting you craft items again and again, so you get the exact item and hoping it doesn't get lost.

[b][*] Customization:[/b] These blueprints are customizable, allowing you to create unique items tailored to your play style. Whether you want something that suits your stealth approach or a heavy-hitting weapon, it could all be made possible.
[/olist]

This system is designed to give you more control over your gear and make the whole process of collecting and crafting more strategic and rewarding. It's a fresh take on item progression that draws inspiration from the mechanics of EVE Online, and looks like it could be a lot of fun to explore.

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1248017227865788436/1279098349122879592/Gif_davinci.gif?ex=66fcbbea&is=66fb6a6a&hm=8a5f38f4e134637e30d474bbc33e57b7e21096117b38dffac1ea8dc0c8e30487&=&width=550&height=309[/img]

Once you've collected enough shards to create a blueprint, you'll need to gather specific materials to craft your items. This is where your strategy comes into play. Different maps and enemies could drop different resources, so you'll need to plan your deployments accordingly. 

What's important here?

[olist]
[b][*] Resource Management:[/b] You'll have to collect specific materials, depending on what you want to make. Some items could be harder to get and require more effort, but the payoff could be worth it.

[b][*] Crafting Mechanics:[/b] Just like in EVE Online, crafting takes real time. You can set your items to be made and then go back to playing while they're cooking in the background. It's all about balancing your time and resources to get the most out of what you find.
[/olist]

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1248017227865788436/1279095601124085882/Gif_3.gif?ex=66fcb95b&is=66fb67db&hm=baae020ddb715dd57417d98e3f57e5899f2b26bc34bb2e46396c6e3efee8e3df&=&width=868&height=488[/img]

We're wrapping up with something special, CHIPSETS!

Like upgrades for your weapons, chipsets could potentially be special items you could create with your blueprints. There could be different types and tiers, so you can customize your setup to fit your playstyle. Whether you want better accuracy, reduced recoil, or something else. This is where you can really make your gear your own!

Why should you care? Chipsets allow you to tweak your blueprints for even more specific results. Want a weapon that fires faster? There could be a chipset for that. Looking for something with higher durability? Potentially...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066515/0a728794a28495672063e7c6508865a31b276f92.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066515/4ebe5d268b90d9a72cc957e599c7fc457d52f433.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066515/122c94a6b2508ba3caae5c267044b2eedf5c6346.png[/img]

This system is designed to give you more control over your items and make your game play experience more enjoyable and personalized. 

We want to make sure this system feels rewarding and fun. Your input on how easy it is to understand, how effective the upgrades feel, and what other options you’d like to see will shape how this potential feature evolves. Let us know your thoughts in the discussion!  

Until next time,
o7
